summary: Iteration 7: Admin profile editing (mobile), Feedback system (backend + frontend bell), PDF date-wise attendance detail. All 11 backend pytest passed. Frontend flows verified at 420px viewport: edit-profile-btn opens dialog with name/mobile/district — save (200) updates settings display; feedback submit closes dialog + toast; dashboard FeedbackBell shows badge=1, auto-opens popover on new item, mark-all-read clears badge; conflicting mobile returns 409; Kannada 'ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ' fits within 344px button on /ledger with no horizontal overflow.

issues: Non-blocking benign ResizeObserver 'loop completed with undelivered notifications' error was captured by CRA dev overlay — occurs after saving profile; does not affect functionality but should be silenced in production build.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1445 lines — recommend splitting into modules (feedback.py, reports.py, auth.py). Non-blocking.
POST /api/auth/profile — mobile field requires district on every save. Consider making district optional if profile is already set (currently must always be re-sent).
FeedbackBell polls every 30s regardless of visibility; consider pausing when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState).
Feedback popover auto-open on new unread works via useEffect on unreadCount only — if two items arrive between polls, seenRef properly tracks IDs. Correct.
PDF generation loads all workers when worker_id filter is set (workers_query filters correctly). No N+1 issue for single-worker case.
Feedback message truncated to 2000 chars server-side (good). No input length hint in UI textarea.
test_credentials: Ephemeral mobile OTP dev flow (dev_otp returned from /api/auth/otp/send).
seed_data_creation: Backend: multiple ephemeral OTP mobile users + TEST_PdfWorker (deleted), TEST_Reg7 (deleted), TEST_C7 (deleted). Frontend: 2 ephemeral mobile users + TEST_UILedger7 (orphan under 2nd user — no cleanup impact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 7 features fully verified. To test PDF text extraction use pypdf (installed). Feedback is per-user scoped. FeedbackBell auto-open triggered via 'feedback:submitted' window event or new unread items during 30s poll. Kannada 'ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ' button uses whitespace-normal wrapping and stays within 420px viewport.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work as specified.
